name: nexstack-pos-monorepo
description: NexStack POS Multi-Tenant SaaS Full-Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build:backend: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
